title: Bolden played only dance jobs; other parade bands
summary: Bolden's was always a dance band, never seen on the street; Jones vaguely recalls the Excelsior and other club parade bands.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Somebody told me once about a Kintype Hall. Did you ever hear of that called Kintype? Like those old fashioned pictures that they take of you. Old photographs, they call it Kintype Hall. Did you ever hear of that?
I don't know where it was.
I don't remember that. It must have been on the outskirts of the city. Might have been.
Did Bolton ever play for parades? Did they ever have a brass band too or just a dance band?
Never all dance bands. All his band was a dance band.
You never saw him out on the street then?
Who would be out on the street? Do you remember any of the street bands? Parade bands? Or bands at fields?

I forget the name of them. I believe the Excelsior. I forget them bands but there used to be a whole lot of them. Oh yeah. All these different clubs used to have, you know, parade and things like that. All used to come right around this corner.
They still do, don't they? But I can't call them. They're Excelsior band.

Well, I can't call all of them. If somebody else called them, I'd know it. Oh yeah. Yeah. You know. You just ask for what you know. Sure, that's all right. You're not constrained. You're not constrained.
Yeah, that's right, yeah. You're something you think, you know. You want to know what you know. He's got a good memory, all right. It's really wonderful that he remembers all that.
